status: Follow-up designed from development summaries before viewing official audit outcomes
contrast: Same 40 patients and initial two masks per patient, warmup, number of training updates, two new masks per patient, calibration roster, and held-apart evaluation patients. The truth-informed diagnostic enters the same assignment rule with mask-derived candidate eligibility; the mixed arm uses the interval policy for half of the patients per phase and the image-guided policy for the other half. The half is selected with a fixed seed before evaluation.
truth_cost: Truth-informed selection needs complete masks for the training pool, so is not cost-equivalent as an acquisition workflow. Intermediate masks used only to select are counted separately as information required. Image-guided policies and the mixed arm require only the 160 dense training masks and zero additional mask lookups for scoring.
analysis: Use all frozen contrasts and report patient-level paired effects, realized FPR and Dice. Match the image-only official outputs against their development acquisition lists, and publish no official test-based tuning. Treat revisions after inspecting the development cohorts as exploratory until this same-source confirmation.
